comments.text:
Dual channel or dual rank?
Strictly speaking a single SODIMM will only report as a single channel but a lot are dual rank.
Rank (99% of the time) means dual-sided meaning it has memory modules on both sides of the stick.
Dual channel is faster (doubling your bandwidth) and dual rank is very slightly slower (doubling the latency between module poling) vs single rank.
